9f11777b23b0.title: Consent to share a health link
9f11777b23b0.content: Skill holder-consent-to-share: The holder decides what a health link (a Verifiable Health Link or a SMART Health Link) shares: which members’ records, protected by which passcode, until when. That choice is the holder’s consent, and the sharer issues nothing beyond it. Input is the records the sharer offers; output is the share request. Performed by a person. Named by: Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and SHL Issuance, Wallet Consent, Health Check and VHL Issuance, Wallet Consent . Performed by a person: the holder (IHE ITI VHL VHL Holder). Role vhl-holder. The sharer that acts on the answer is vhl-share for a VHL; for a SMART Health Link it is the SHL sharer, which sets the link’s P flag and exp from the same answer. Which kind of link is the sharer’s, not the holder’s, choice.

b0c09b1d6216.title: Scan a health credential
b0c09b1d6216.content: Skill receiver-scan-credential: The health worker at a receiving system scans the QR a holder shows (an HCERT, a VHL carried in an HCERT, or a SMART Health Link) and, for a passcode-protected health link, enters the passcode the holder says. Input is the QR as shown; output is its text (and passcode) handed to the receiving system, which verifies it or follows the link. Performed by a person; never judges authenticity. Performed by a person: the health worker operating a receiving system (a CHW app, a clinic EHR, a point-of-care viewer). Role receiving-health-worker. What happens to the scan is the system’s: hcert-verify (or its unverified triage read) and vhl-receive; for a SMART Health Link, the SHL receiver’s manifest request.
